after_fill: Count confirmed shares only. Manual S touch/below triggers exit pending. M is not a second intraday stop on the filled position; canonical Stage4 structural rule governs. R remains original initial fill minus initial S.
orders: Hypothetical DAY limit no higher than67.50, regular session only, no order submitted; verify no duplicate/uncertain CTSH order.
